faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before deploying Lexon AI.

items.question: How is Lexon AI licensed?
items.answer: Lexon AI is licensed annually for organizations and includes unlimited internal users, local deployment, product updates, and deployment assistance.

items.question: Can Lexon AI be deployed entirely within our infrastructure?
items.answer: Yes. Lexon AI is designed for self-hosted deployments, allowing contract data, AI models, embeddings, and document storage to remain inside your environment.

items.question: How does Lexon AI review contracts?
items.answer: Lexon AI compares every contract against your organization's uploaded policies, legal playbooks, clause library, and previous review guidance to generate consistent, policy-aware recommendations.

items.question: Can we customize review policies and clause libraries?
items.answer: Yes. Organizations can upload internal policies, preferred clause language, legal playbooks, and historical guidance to create a knowledge base tailored to their review process.

items.question: Does Lexon AI require cloud AI services?
items.answer: No. Lexon AI supports local AI inference and private deployments without requiring mandatory third-party AI APIs.

items.question: What happens after purchasing a license?
items.answer: Our team assists with deployment, environment configuration, knowledge base setup, and onboarding so your organization can begin reviewing contracts using its own legal knowledge.
